page.notes: The page carries no running text. Along the left edge, in the dark binding strip, there are large capital letters, rotated with the scan: an "A" near the top, a "D" below it, then "C" and "L" close together near the middle. I cannot tell whether these are printed edge letters or gathering marks from the neighbouring page, so I have not transcribed them as text. The dark marks and shadows along the left edge are binding and show-through. The "Digitized by Google" banner at the bottom right is excluded. Small specks and stains across the page are not printed.
